propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate deployed the pump-failure model into the production work-order planner on 19 September 2023 and tracked alert precision weekly for the following quarter.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the deployment, the release note gives the production date, rollback procedure and 12 weeks of precision, and the reference check confirms planners acted on the alerts.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate packaged the model as a versioned container with a model card and schema checks run in CI.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the packaging and tests.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate agreed an alert-handling procedure with five field supervisors, including a 48-hour inspection target.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the procedure directly.

expectedGap: Weekly precision figures were shared in a team channel; a monthly report to operations management is not documented.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the production release with its date, release note and rollback procedure, and the 12 weeks of monitoring; do not turn the channel posts into management reporting.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether alert precision was reported to operations management and in what form.
